[[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] | draft_year = | career_start = 2015 | years1 = 2015–2016 | team1 = Lietuvos rytas-2 | years3 = 2016–present | team3 = →[[Perlas (basketball club)|Perlas]] | years2 = 2016–present | team2 = [[BC Lietuvos rytas|Lietuvos rytas Vilnius / Rytas Vilnius]] | highlights = * [[Karaliaus Mindaugo taurė|King Mindaugas Cup]] winner (2019) *[[EuroLeague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Next Generation Tournament]] MVP (2018) | medaltemplates = }} '''Deividas Sirvydis''' (born 10 June 2000) is a Lithuanian professional [[basketball]] player for [[BC Rytas|Rytas Vilnius]] of the [[Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL). Standing 2.02 m (6 ft 8 in), he plays the [[shooting guard]] position. == Early life == Sirvydis spent his childhood in various European countries because of his father's professional basketball career. He lived for three years in [[Russia]], two years in [[Germany]], and one year in the [[Czech Republic]], and one year in [[Cyprus]]. Sirvydis often practiced basketball after his father's games but did not seriously start playing the sport until he was about seven years old.{{cite web |last1=Hein |first1=David |title=Sirvydis keeps etching his name in annals of Rytas history |url=https://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/8hoewki9ubhwv7fs/sirvydis-keeps-etching-his-name-in-annals-of-rytas-history |publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]] |accessdate=10 May 2019 |date=24 January 2018}} == Professional career == Sirvydis made his LKL debut on 29 May 2017, when he was 16 years old, passing [[Jonas Valančiūnas]] as the youngest player in club history to play in the league. On 5 December, he became the youngest Lietuvos rytas player to appear in a [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] game, overtaking Valančiūnas again. Playing for the [[BC Lietuvos rytas|Lietuvos rytas]] under-18 team, Sirvydis won the 2018 [[EuroLeague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]]. He was named [[most valuable player]] (MVP) after recording 18 points, 6 rebounds and 3 assists in the championship versus [[A.S. Stella Azzurra|Stella Azzurra Rome]] under-18 team.{{cite web |title=Rytas guard Sirvydis named ANGT MVP |url=https://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/8r35meqnjihofupj/rytas-guard-sirvydis-named-angt-mvp |publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament]] |accessdate=10 May 2019 |date=20 May 2018}} == Personal life == Sirvydis is the son of Virginijus Sirvydis, a former professional [[basketball]] player who played in many European countries, winning the [[North European Basketball League]] (NEBL) championship in 2001 with Russian club [[PBC Ural Great Perm|Ural Great Perm]].{{cite web |title=Virginijus Sirvydis |url=http://www.nklyga.lt/zaidejai/3701-virginijus-sirvydis.html |publisher=[[National Basketball League (Lithuania)|National Basketball League]] |accessdate=10 May 2019 |language=Lithuanian}} In 2012, Virginijus began his coaching career as an assistant for LKL club [[BC Sakalai|Sakalai Vilnius]].{{cite web |title=„Sakalų“ vyr. treneriu tapo Petronis, jam talkins Sirvydis |url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-52914-sakalu-vyr-treneriu-tapo-petronis-jam-talkins-sirvydis.html |publisher=BasketNews |accessdate=10 May 2019 |date=10 August 2012}} == References == {{Reflist}} {{BC Lietuvos Rytas current roster}} {{Euroleague NGT MVP}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Sirvydis, Deividas}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:BC Rytas players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
